name: Aude
shape: Eurostat NUTS, the area it is named for

climate: Syrah, Merlot and Grenache sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A department-wide IGP wine from the Aude, one of France's vins de pays. The most planted grapes there are Syrah (16 percent), Merlot and Carignan (15 each), then Grenache and Chardonnay (12 each).
